snippet.title: MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries - Ashes & Ascension - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
MechWarrior 5 Mercenaries - Ashes & Ascension - Release Date Oct 6th
https://mw5mercs.com/buy-ashes-and-ascension

Ashes & Ascension includes:
- An 18-mission campaign, our longest yet with New Cinematics
- 13 new Clan 'Mechs
- New Inner Sphere OmniMechs
- New Inner Sphere 'Mech variants
- New Inner Sphere weapons

Read the full Ashes & Ascension details:
https://mw5mercs.com/dlc/ashes-and-ascension
